sourcePackageRelease.scope: PocketRoot source and Swift Package metadata only; no RootFS, XCFramework mirror, App, archive, IPA, or binary SDK asset.

gates.title: Source release excludes the RootFS payload
gates.titleZh: 源码发布不包含 RootFS 载荷
gates.requiredAction: Keep the RootFS outside Git, SwiftPM resources, and source-release assets.

gates.title: Public API status is declared experimental
gates.titleZh: 公共 API 状态已声明为 Experimental
gates.requiredAction: Keep the Experimental label until a separately reviewed stability decision is recorded.

gates.title: Top-level PocketRoot license is finalized
gates.titleZh: PocketRoot 顶层许可证已确定
gates.requiredAction: Select an SPDX license and replace the current no-permission placeholder with its complete terms.

gates.title: Contributor and copyright policy is approved
gates.titleZh: 贡献者与版权政策已批准
gates.requiredAction: Record the contributor, copyright, and inbound-license policy.

gates.title: Source-release notice is approved
gates.titleZh: 源码发行 NOTICE 已批准
gates.requiredAction: Approve the release notice covering PocketRoot and referenced third-party source dependencies.

gates.title: PocketRoot source release is explicitly authorized
gates.titleZh: PocketRoot 源码发布已明确授权
gates.requiredAction: Record the approving owner and date after every source-release gate is satisfied.

runtimeDistribution.scope: Any App, binary SDK, TestFlight/App Store build, or redistributed runtime artifact; excludes every RootFS asset, which remains a caller-provided local input.

gates.title: Top-level PocketRoot license is finalized for runtime distribution
gates.titleZh: Runtime 分发使用的 PocketRoot 顶层许可证已确定
gates.requiredAction: Select an SPDX license and replace the current no-permission placeholder before distributing any runtime binary or App.

gates.title: RootFS remains a caller-provided local input
gates.titleZh: RootFS 保持为调用方提供的本地输入
gates.evidence: COMPOSITION.json finalArtifactEvidence, ARTIFACT-INVENTORY.json, SBOM.spdx.json, and release decisions
gates.requiredAction: Scan the exact final artifact, record its reviewed SHA-256, and verify its inventory contains no RootFS payload.

gates.title: Final signed and exported artifact is built and scanned
gates.titleZh: 最终签名导出制品已构建并扫描
gates.evidence: COMPOSITION.json coverage and finalArtifactEvidence bound to the reviewed artifact SHA-256
gates.requiredAction: Build the final signed/exported artifact and generate its complete file inventory, binary scan, entitlements, and SBOM.

gates.title: Complete LICENSE and NOTICE bundle is approved
gates.titleZh: 完整 LICENSE 与 NOTICE 交付包已批准
gates.evidence: COMPOSITION.json, RootFS review evidence, and release decisions
gates.requiredAction: Complete and approve the distribution LICENSE/NOTICE set, including the remaining alpine-keys material decision.

gates.title: Corresponding-source delivery is approved
gates.evidence: COMPOSITION.json, RootFS source evidence, and release decisions
gates.requiredAction: Materialize, verify, and approve the corresponding-source delivery and source-offer mechanism.

gates.title: App Store executable-code policy is approved
gates.titleZh: App Store 可执行代码策略已批准
gates.requiredAction: Approve the written policy for shell, network, apk, downloaded code, and App Review disclosure.

gates.title: Runtime privacy and data-lifecycle review is approved
gates.titleZh: Runtime 隐私与数据生命周期评审已批准
gates.requiredAction: Approve storage, backup exclusion, logs, network, secrets, deletion, and privacy-manifest behavior.

gates.title: Complete runtime distribution legal review is approved
gates.titleZh: 完整 Runtime 分发法律评审已批准
gates.requiredAction: Approve the combined PocketRoot, IshEmbed/iSH, SwiftTerm, RootFS, and final-artifact distribution composition.

gates.title: Runtime binary/App distribution is explicitly authorized
gates.titleZh: Runtime 二进制/App 分发已明确授权
gates.requiredAction: Record the approving owner and date only after every runtime distribution gate is satisfied.

nextRequiredDecision.reason: Select an SPDX license and replace the current no-permission placeholder with its complete terms.

warning: Engineering validation is not distribution authorization. A ready source track would not authorize runtime, RootFS, App, or binary distribution.
